verdict.line: You lose the trade exchange level 1-5 if you walk up for CS into free Q (Blinding Dart) and Toxic Shot autos, but you flip the matchup the moment R (Realm of Death) comes online at 6 and traps him in an isolated duel he can't kite out of.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser has zero ranged answer to Teemo's Q (Blinding Dart, 680 range) and passive E (Toxic Shot) poison before level 6, so Teemo dictates every trade in the early levels purely by staying at range. Everything inverts at 6: R (Realm of Death) drags Teemo into an isolated 1v1 where his only tools for escaping melee — W (Move Quick) and Camouflage — simply don't function, which is exactly how the 95-game head-to-head's lane and solo-kill edge gets converted into kills. The overall 43.2% Mordekaiser win rate despite that lane edge points to Teemo clawing games back after laning phase with split-push and R (Noxious Trap) zone control.

theirWindow.when: Whenever his Blinding Dart (Q) is up
theirWindow.what: He'll poke and blind on an 8s cycle as you approach for CS, and every auto he lands during this window stacks Toxic Shot (E) poison on top. Don't walk into auto range to trade — only answer with Q (Obliterate) at 675 range, since it's your longest reach before level 6.

yourWindow.when: The 8s right after he fires Blinding Dart (Q)
yourWindow.what: His only safety tool is down. Step in with E (Death's Grasp, 700 range) to pull him into melee, then burst with Q (Obliterate) and autos to stack Darkness Rise before he can blind you again.

powerCurve.note: Ranged poke blinds you, farming is risky
R isolates him, Q burst spikes
Shrooms and split-push claw back equity

start.why: The flat damage reduction on first hits and the extra regen directly offset Teemo's free poke harass and Toxic Shot DoT chip while you farm at a distance disadvantage.

boots.why: Every point of Teemo damage — Q, Toxic Shot, Noxious Trap — is magic, so flat magic resist blunts his entire kit at once; Plated Steelcaps does nothing against an auto-attacker with no real physical burst here.

core.why: The slow on Q and E lets you actually catch Move Quick instead of watching him kite off after you pull him in.
Omnivamp and the ramping true-damage bonus let you win extended skirmishes even while eating ongoing poison ticks.
Magic resist plus heal amp stacks directly with W's (Indestructible) self-heal and Riftmaker's omnivamp against an all-magic-damage opponent.

situational.when: he keeps kiting toward brush or the jungle to escape with Move Quick
the game goes long and you need more sustained single-target DPS in skirmishes
their jungler or mid starts diving you once the lane is already won

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror's ramping adaptive force rewards exactly the extended, sustained trades this lane turns into after 6 — stacks persist through the whole R duel, so you hit max damage right as he's trapped with you.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 69.4% of games here; Ignite's grievous wounds denies the sustain Teemo gets from standing still, and it reveals him the instant he tries to vanish with Camouflage. Exhaust+Flash posted the strongest recorded win rate (69.2% over a smaller sample) and is worth taking instead if you want a harder answer to Move Quick kiting specifically.

playing.title: Trade only with Q pre-6
playing.detail: Teemo outranges your autos with Q (Blinding Dart, 680 range) and free Toxic Shot autos, so before level 6 only engage with Q (Obliterate, 675 range) — walking up for autos just feeds him stacking poison for free.

playing.title: Pull with E once his Q is down
playing.detail: E (Death's Grasp, 700 range, 16s CD at rank 1) is your only way to force him into melee since he has no displacement besides Move Quick's speed — use it the moment his Blinding Dart is on cooldown.

playing.title: All-in with R at level 6
playing.detail: R (Realm of Death) isolates him in a pocket dimension where Move Quick and Camouflage don't function — this is the close-quarters fight OP.GG's own note is pointing at.

playing.title: Track Noxious Trap bushes
playing.detail: R (Noxious Trap) has a near-zero 1s recast, so Teemo can cheaply carpet tri-bush and jungle entrances with mushrooms — ward or sidestep known shroom spots instead of walking straight into brush to trade.

playing.title: Bank passive stacks through Blind
playing.detail: Darkness Rise only needs 3 landed attacks or spells against champions — if Blinding Dart stops your autos, keep stacking it with Q and E, both of which still land through a blind.

playing.title: Pop W to heal, not just shield
playing.detail: Indestructible (W) is leveled last in this build, so don't lean on it for a shield before roughly level 8-9 — once it's up, bank damage into it and consume it for healing right as Toxic Shot's DoT is ticking you down.

playing.title: Don't overextend after laning phase
playing.detail: The 43.2% overall win rate despite a lane edge means Teemo claws games back with split-push and shroom vision denial — group for objectives instead of letting him freely roam once laning phase ends.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win/pick rates above are measured from live games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning, timing windows, and in-game calls built around them are my own tactical read.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of being punished during level 2~3 while focusing on farming lane with your skills. After reaching level 6, use [P] to fight Teemo in close quarters to kill him.
